intro: Our Indian visa FAQs answer the questions we’re asked most about Indian e-Visas and visas. Can’t see yours? Call or WhatsApp us.

faqs.q: Can I apply myself instead of using you?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply on the official website, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee. People use us when they want a person to check their eligibility, fix their photo and documents, and handle the form for them so nothing goes wrong.
At least 4 days before you arrive in India, and no more than 120 days before. We recommend applying 2 to 3 weeks ahead in case anything needs correcting.

faqs.q: How long does an Indian e-Visa take?
faqs.a: Most complete applications are decided within a few working days. Apply at least 4 days before you arrive, and ideally 2 to 3 weeks ahead.
It depends on the main reason for your trip: e-Tourist for holidays and family visits, e-Business for business trips, e-Medical for treatment, and so on. See all the [e-Visa types](/indian-e-visa/).

faqs.q: Do I need to send my passport?
faqs.a: Not for an e-Visa: everything is online. For a regular visa, your passport is submitted at the visa application centre.

faqs.q: I’m British with Pakistani heritage. Can I get an e-Visa?
faqs.a: Usually not. If your parents or grandparents were born in or lived permanently in Pakistan, you need a regular visa.

faqs.q: My passport is due to expire. Can I still apply?
faqs.a: Your passport must be valid for at least six months when you apply, with two blank pages. If it’s close, renew it first.

faqs.q: Is the e-Visa fee refundable if I’m refused?
faqs.a: No. The Government of India’s e-Visa fee pays for processing your application, so it isn’t refunded if the visa is refused or you cancel your trip. That’s why we check everything before you pay it.

faqs.q: What happens when I land in India?
faqs.a: Show your printed e-Visa (ETA) at immigration. Your fingerprints and photo are taken and the visa is stamped in your passport. You must arrive at an airport or seaport approved for e-Visas.

faqs.q: Do children need their own e-Visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Every traveller, including babies and children, needs their own passport and e-Visa.
A free online form you can fill in within 72 hours before arriving in India. It isn’t a visa. [Read our guide](/india-e-arrival-card/).

faqs.q: Can I visit India for work on an e-Visa?
faqs.a: No. Paid work needs an [Employment visa](/indian-work-visa/).
